1/ We can use 2D CNN to represent temporal data, with timestamp x features as spatial dim and 1 channel
t1: f1 f2 f3
t2: f1 f2 f3
t3: f1 f2 f3
=> the combination of features occurring at three consecutive time steps is important

2/ work by anthropic on mechanistic interpretability https://transformer-circuits.pub/2022/mech-interp-essay/index.html
superposition: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2022/toy_model/index.html
other work (mechanistic interpretability): https://neuralblog.github.io/logit-prisms/index.pdf
early attempts at explainability and causal ML: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/artificial-intelligence/explainable-artificial-intelligencexai/
do-calculus: https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/causal-models/do-calculus.html

3/ lagrangian constraints (not causal task but worth trying)
